corrections.value: Stand at the southernmost point of mainland Canada where Lake Erie currents meet.
corrections.quote: The Tip observation area is ideal for viewing the sunrise over the lake
corrections.reason: Geographical error: The park is on Lake Erie, not Lake Huron.

corrections.value: Point Pelee is temporarily closed to visitors from November 12 to 23, 2026. General park admission fees apply at the gate. Accommodation within the park is limited to oTENTik units in Camp Henry which require advance reservation through the Parks Canada booking system; verify all seasonal hours on the official site.
corrections.quote: Point Pelee National Park is temporarily closed to visitors November 12 to 23, 2026.
corrections.reason: Current closure notice: The park is closed during the dates specified in the audit request (today is 2026-11-15).

summary: The travel plan is largely supported by Parks Canada documentation regarding trails, shuttle operations, and accommodation types. A significant geographical error regarding the surrounding Great Lake (Erie vs Huron) was corrected. Most importantly, a temporary closure notice for November 12-23, 2026, was added as it impacts the immediate travel window. Airport and signal roaming details are unverified or inferred from regional context.
